result.summary: APP SINGLE baseline is partially implemented and must remain in-progress. Android video, IMU and ToF capture/persistence/upload wiring exists; server storage and station transfer paths exist; visual COLMAP reconstruction and diagnostics exist. Available evidence does not independently runtime-verify the complete sidecar path for the reference capture. IMU affects frame selection and post-COLMAP diagnostics but does not constrain mapper or bundle adjustment. ToF produces calibrated metric observations and measurement-only scale/depth diagnostics but does not mutate poses, sparse/dense geometry, scale or fusion. Hybrid v1 and exhaustive historical results show improved visual connectivity, while controlled Hybrid v2 is not run and its README contradicts the executable loop-detection setting. No physical-ground-truth metric result exists.

tests.command: No build, unit test, device capture, COLMAP job or physical-ground-truth run executed
tests.summary: ANALYZE mode used read-only source and documentation inspection only.

evidence: app/MaklerTour/app/src/main/java/com/example/maklertour/data/phonecamera/PhoneCameraScanProvider.kt starts/stops ImuRecorder and TofCaptureSidecarRecorder and writes sidecars to the manifest.
app/MaklerTour/app/src/main/java/com/example/maklertour/auth/MobileUploadApi.kt attaches imu, tof_frames and tof_calibration multipart parts.
web/www/api/mobile.php stores optional IMU/ToF files; web/remote_station/run_extract_frames_job.sh transfers them to the station.
docs/SINGLE_BASELINE_AUDIT.md historically claims IMU/ToF capture and server output for job_180237696.
docs/SINGLE_IMU_PARTICIPATION_AUDIT.md and docs/SINGLE_TOF_PARTICIPATION_AUDIT.md both state RUNTIME NOT RUN.
acceptanceResults.notes: Implemented end-to-end wiring and a historical claim exist, but reference job artifacts/logs were unavailable for independent validation. The completed=true state in the originating WorkItem is stronger than the accessible evidence.

evidence: web/remote_station/scripts/process_colmap_sparse.sh creates sparse_diagnostics.json and sparse_components.json.
web/remote_station/scripts/analyze_sparse_trajectory.py reports registration, reprojection and trajectory metrics.
experiments/single_hybrid_v2/diagnostics.py implements registered images, components, sparse points, reprojection, first/last frame and endpoint distance.
docs/SINGLE_VISUAL_LOOP_CLOSURE_AB_AUDIT.md records concrete sequential/exhaustive runtime metrics for job_180237696.
acceptanceResults.notes: Satisfied for research/audit diagnostics. Metrics are distributed across production and experimental outputs rather than one uniformly runtime-accepted production artifact.

evidence: docs/SINGLE_HYBRID_LOOP_RESULT.md reports Hybrid v1 improved largest model 204 to 440 and components 6 to 3.
experiments/single_hybrid_v2/generate_pairs.py implements a bounded non-exhaustive controlled pair graph.
docs/SINGLE_HYBRID_V2_AUDIT.md reports all Hybrid v2 metrics NOT_RUN.
experiments/single_hybrid_v2/README.md says loop detection enabled, while experiments/single_hybrid_v2/run.sh sets --SequentialMatching.loop_detection 0.
acceptanceResults.notes: Hybrid v1 is supporting historical evidence, not acceptance of the controlled Hybrid v2 policy. The exact controlled experiment has not run.

evidence: web/remote_station/scripts/process_colmap_sparse.sh runs feature_extractor, visual matcher and ordinary colmap mapper before locating IMU for diagnostics.
web/remote_station/scripts/build_world_alignment.py returns UNALIGNED with identity rotation because device-to-COLMAP transform is not implemented.
docs/SINGLE_IMU_PARTICIPATION_AUDIT.md classifies IMU as PARTIAL and explicitly finds no pose prior or inertial bundle-adjustment constraint.
acceptanceResults.notes: IMU is captured and can influence pre-COLMAP frame selection, but it does not enter the mapper/BA objective or apply gravity alignment.

evidence: web/remote_station/scripts/process_extract_frames.sh generates tof_metric_observations.jsonl for measurement.
web/remote_station/scripts/measure_tof_sparse_scale.py fixes measurement_only=true, geometry_mutation_enabled=false, camera_poses_modified=false, points3d_modified=false and fusion_enabled=false.
docs/SINGLE_TOF_PARTICIPATION_AUDIT.md classifies ToF as METRIC ONLY and finds no COLMAP/PatchMatch constraint or automatic scale application.
acceptanceResults.notes: ToF is calibrated and consumed for diagnostics, but it does not change camera poses, sparse/dense geometry, bundle adjustment, scale or fusion.

evidence: docs/SINGLE_PIPELINE_CURRENT_STATE.md states metric reconstruction is NOT IMPLEMENTED and requires controlled Video-only, Video+IMU and Video+IMU+ToF comparisons.
docs/SINGLE_VISUAL_LOOP_CLOSURE_AB_AUDIT.md explicitly states that no ground-truth object geometry measurement was performed.
No repository artifact defines accepted physical dimensions, metric-error thresholds or a repeatable sensor-assisted result.
acceptanceResults.notes: The required physical-ground-truth experiment and acceptance thresholds are absent.

assumptions: docs/SINGLE_BASELINE_AUDIT.md is treated as a historical claim about job_180237696, not independently verified runtime evidence.
The source tree inspected is the implementation corresponding to the originating reconciled ProjectNavigator task.
No inaccessible remote station or /mnt/storage artifacts are assumed to exist or pass acceptance.
warnings: Reference job runtime artifacts and logs were unavailable locally, so capture-to-retention criterion remains NOT_TESTED despite implemented wiring and historical documentation.
Hybrid v2 documentation and executable code disagree on loop detection; results would be ambiguous until the contract is reconciled.
Improved visual connectivity does not establish physical loop closure, metric scale or geometric correctness.

ToF server storage is optional and downstream recovery partly relies on sidecar filenames; this is a robustness risk, not reported as a new Issue because the existing ToF geometry Issue already covers the material acceptance gap.
